annotations.text:
Chunk It AI panel — designed against ai-Plan.md

Three properties, in priority order: reliable, legible, grounded.
Tokens are lifted from src/styles/design-system.css (Charcoal & Signal): Outfit, Hot Coral #ff5040, 40px panel body, 18px composer, 8px controls.

W1 — the trace names the OBJECT, never the verb.

"Searching: beta launch checklist saas 2026", not "Analysing". The four queries are printed verbatim, the cards read are chips you can click, and the plan carries the model's one-sentence justification for choosing a board.

During a run the composer is REPLACED by the run bar — one focus at a time.

W5 — every artifact is its own row with its own receipt: block count against the effort budget, and what it was grounded on.

Because bodies are written one call each, three good cards survive a fourth that fails. The gap-analysis card (amber) is W6: what the canvas is MISSING, which no competitor does.

W4 — two kinds of citation.

Coral pills are cards on your canvas (click to fly there). Grey [1] [2] are web sources, placed inline from Gemini's groundingSupports spans — which today we throw away and staple to the bottom as a list.

Drag handles and the hover action bar are the parts of today's panel that already work. Kept exactly.

W2 — the clarify form.

Every question ships pre-answered, so Continue without touching anything is a sane run, and "Just answer" skips the whole thing. Fires on under ~25% of turns: never on a direct question, never on Fast.

W3 + W8 — the fix for six unlabeled icon toggles.

State 1 is the honest empty state: nothing attached, answering from general knowledge. The canvas is read ONLY when a chip says so — no more regex sniffing the question for the word "note".

Effort states its consequence, not its name.
W4 — provenance outlives the chat. A card found three weeks later still names the prompt, model, effort and sources that made it, and the canvas can filter to Created by AI.
